label: Modal spine Arrival B: the sense of B1's beginning and its connection to the metric Grim Reaper
summary: Target: modal spine stage one, Arrival B premise B1 (8ea0321d), toward STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT (b19ffd92) and STMT-GOD-EXISTS; connect the metric Grim Reaper (attempt 5f4e157a, populatedPastsMetricallyFiniteOfPatchwork, conclusion 4365c3c5) to a root route. Spec: specs/modal-spine-metric-beginning-arrival.toml. Repaired after the independent semantic challenge (accept with repairs). SENSE FINDING. B1 as typed (PossibleCauseOfContingency.PossiblyBeginsAt) fixes no sense of beginning: the Scenario has no times and beginsContingency : World -> Prop is an uninterpreted field. The existing Arrival B theorems hold for every predicate, including the constant True used by their controls. DEF-POSSIBLE-CAUSAL-OPPORTUNITY (6343c7e8) called it a 'stipulated first obtaining' with a 'causal bearer', which the type does not enforce; its text is amended to the supplied, unconstrained predicate (BEGINS_3) and an unconstrained cause relation, and it is no longer linked from 256b5bab. Before this attempt, Arrival B concluded the Scenario statement 679eb3f7, not b19ffd92, and B1 and B2 did not reach the GOD_4 root. DISAMBIGUATION BEGINS (dc40914a). BEGINS_1 (FirstMomentBeginningAt): the time before every populated moment of the history has a first moment. BEGINS_2 (FiniteDurationBeginningAt): that time is of finite duration on the supplied clock, CLOCK_1 intended; with a bounded clock it reduces to population. BEGINS_3 (ContingencyBeginsAt): a schematic placeholder fixing no sense, now linked from 8ea0321d and df89f0d2. BEGINS_1 and BEGINS_2 constrain time, not when contingent reality began: integer time empty before 0 and populated from 0 on has contingent reality beginning a finite time ago and satisfies neither; non-negative real time empty at 0 and populated after it satisfies BEGINS_1 with no first populated moment. A fourth sense, a first populated moment after emptiness (related to A3), is named and not formalized. RESULTS (TruthCore.Causality.MetricBeginningArrival). (1) possiblyBeginsFiniteDurationOfMetricallyFinite (result 22dbb73a): metrically finite populated pasts (4365c3c5) and possible population (faa1ff28) give B1 in sense BEGINS_2 (951a2235); non-transcription. (2) possiblyFiniteDurationOfFirstMoment (8da13191): in linear time B1 in sense BEGINS_1 (b58d1aac) strengthens B1 in sense BEGINS_2 (registered strengthens relation, sense bridge BEGINS_1 to BEGINS_2); strict by control 2. (3) necessaryConcreteOfFiniteDurationBeginning (8f77abb0): Euclidean access at the selected world (1b1462e6), actual reflexivity, B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 (256b5bab) give b19ffd92; declared an instantiation of ActualEuclidean.externalNecessaryConcrete. (4) possiblyNecessaryOfFiniteDurationOpportunity (54bf1664): B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 give possibly a necessary concrete individual (d2d7cf61), with no frame premise; declared an instantiation of ExternalCandidateNecessity. (5) controls (ebf324e3): in the integer history pivot possible population holds and B1 in sense BEGINS_2 fails; in openBelow (positive reals) Euclidean access and reflexivity at true hold, B1 holds in sense BEGINS_2 and not BEGINS_1, B2 in sense BEGINS_2 fails for the empty cause relation, and no concrete individual is necessary at either world; in openBelowSource the whole bundle and the conclusion hold. Helper trivialCauseOpportunity (not a corpus result): B2 for any cause relation gives B2 for the relation that always holds, which is all the arrival uses. FRONTIER. Computed frontier-diff (root GOD_4 exists): the spaced Reaper premises 37d4e072 and bb7b476c, possible population faa1ff28 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 256b5bab now reach the root as bare leaves (276 to 280 open; 170 to 174 bare; supported 72 to 72). 4365c3c5 and 951a2235 are not open leaves: 'supported' is a source depth (a supports relation or a non-byte-verified stating claim), and intermediate conclusions of verified non-transcription arguments are expanded into their premises; they appear as the 2 added verified support alternatives. HOW MUCH IT BUYS. The Reaper reaches the root only through Arrival B, and the decisive premise there is B2. Its cause relation is an unconstrained parameter, so, given B1, its content is that possibly a BEGINS_2 history contains an existing concrete individual outside the contingent totality, which by ExternalCandidateNecessity is a necessary concrete individual of that history: close to stipulating the possibility of the target. A rival who denies that possibility rejects B2 outright; the arrival does not discriminate against that rival. B1 in sense BEGINS_2 is the cheap premise: given the Reaper conclusion every accessible populated history is a BEGINS_2 history (analyst observation from the definitions, not registered), and under L (solutions of accepted laws are possible), the principle of the FLRW objection to begun pasts, a possible populated FLRW history gives it without any Reaper premise (not formalized). The Reaper's contribution is interpretive: it makes the possible populated histories BEGINS_2 histories, in which a causal-opportunity principle for beginnings would apply if one were granted for BEGINS_2 histories; no warrant for such a principle is on file. Arrival A still cannot use the metric conclusion. OBJECTION AND WARRANT AUDIT (Substantive Objection Standard). B1 in sense BEGINS_2: no substantive objection identified (no recorded argument that in every possible populated history the time before some populated moment is metrically infinite); the open Misner-type objection targets the CLOCK_1 choice; the Reaper route inherits the undercutting objection to spaced patchwork (5f4e157a). Possible population: no substantive objection identified. B2 in sense BEGINS_2: no positive warrant on file. The reviewed 2026-11-11 audit of the parameter-sense premise (docs/notes/causal-temporal-rival-coverage.md, 'Positive modal causal opportunity'; attempt 169b007b) applies unchanged: (a) the causal marker and the beginning predicate do no work in ExternalCandidateNecessity, and here the cause relation is an unconstrained parameter; (b) source-availability defeater against B2's warrant: causal uniformity from ordinary caused beginnings preserves the effect's intrinsic character but not a producer once every contingent producer is removed from the prehistory, and a necessary producer is admissible only if the disputed population question is settled; (c) contingent-natural restriction rival, motivated by the difference between producing within an inventory and producing the first inventory, at the price of an explanatory stop or an unspecified intrinsic account of the initial inventory. (d) First-instant objection (Grünbaum-type, analyst formulation, not read from a source): an open-below finite past has no instant at which contingent reality comes to be, so a uniformity argument from ordinary beginnings (coming to be at an instant after an earlier state) has no matching instance among open-below BEGINS_2 histories; it targets B2's warrant, not the typed premise, whose cause relation carries no temporal constraint. The brute-beginning rival survives as a model (control 2), which shows B2 is needed, not that it is false. Nothing is attributed to any author. No premise is established.
blocker: B2 in sense BEGINS_2 (256b5bab) is OPEN with no positive warrant on file; with an unconstrained cause relation it amounts, given B1, to the possibility of an existing concrete individual outside the contingent totality, so it carries the possibility of a necessary concrete individual (54bf1664) and the connection does not discriminate against a rival who denies that possibility. Its warrant faces the source-availability defeater, the contingent-natural restriction rival and the first-instant objection. The spaced Reaper premises remain OPEN under the undercutting objection of attempt 5f4e157a. Next tests: a causal-opportunity principle for BEGINS_2 histories with a constrained cause relation whose warrant does not already contain possible necessary being; formalize the unformalized sense 'first populated moment after emptiness' and compare it with A3; a metric counterpart of Arrival A's inert-emptiness step needing no empty moment; register the implication from L-style FLRW possibility to B1 in sense BEGINS_2 if L is formalized.
